source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a MECHA personification of the element IRON (Fe) itself — the sovereign of the Iron Nation — in THE FUTURE. A female mecha personification character with iron as her motif — the element reimagined as an armored woman: plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry its materials, colors, shapes and motifs. ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
MECHA DESIGN: heavy dark-iron plating with brushed-steel edges, visible rivets and I-beam girder shapes in her pauldrons and greaves, a magnetic field drawn as hovering iron-filing arcs and a halo of orbiting shards behind her, forge-orange glow lines along the seams, a rusted patina band across one shoulder as a mark of age, a back unit shaped like a blast-furnace crown. She does NOT hold or carry anything; both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ERA — THE FUTURE, year 2150: an orbital iron foundry over a red-dust asteroid, molten metal pouring in zero gravity into glowing molds, magnetic rails, stars and a distant sun, hard rim light. 
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
